entries.text: The lint job collects the test suite once. `make lint-markers` collects with `--assert=plain` and records every test's markers to `$MARKER_MANIFEST`; the fast-lane guard (`fast_lane_ceiling_check.py --manifest-from-env`, or `--manifest <path>`) evaluates each forbidden marker expression and path substring against that record with pytest's own marker-expression evaluation, instead of running one full collection per expression. Without either option the guard collects for itself, so a leftover `MARKER_MANIFEST` in a shell is never read by accident. Collection errors, unregistered markers, a collection timeout and a record with no tests fail; violations and counts are unchanged.
